title: Subscribe control is not keyboard accessible
wcag: 2.1.1 Keyboard (Level A), 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (Level A)
description: The newsletter 'Subscribe' control is a <div> with an onclick handler. It cannot be reached with Tab or activated with Enter/Space, and screen readers do not announce it as a button.
fix: Use a native <button type="submit"> inside a <form>.

title: Keyboard focus is invisible
description: The stylesheet removes the outline from every focused element (*:focus { outline: none }). Keyboard users cannot see where they are on the page.
fix: Remove the global rule and add a visible :focus-visible style (e.g. 3px solid outline with offset).

title: Form fields rely on placeholder text instead of labels
wcag: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (Level A), 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (Level A)
description: The search and email fields have no <label>. The placeholder disappears while typing and is not reliably announced by all assistive technologies.
fix: Add a <label for> for each field (visually hidden for the search field if needed) and autocomplete="email" on the email field.

title: Missing page structure: no landmarks, no H1, skipped heading levels
wcag: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (Level A), 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (Level A), 2.4.6 Headings and Labels (Level AA)
description: The page has no <header>, <nav> or <main> landmarks and no skip link. The main headline is a styled <div>, and headings jump from H4 to H5.
fix: Add header/nav/main landmarks, a 'Skip to main content' link, a single H1, and sequential H2/H3 headings.

title: Ambiguous link and button text
wcag: 2.4.4 Link Purpose (Level A), 2.5.8 Target Size (Level AA)
description: Links read 'here' and buttons read '+', which give no context out of context. The '+' buttons are also smaller than the 24×24 px minimum target size.
fix: Use descriptive text ('Read our privacy policy', 'Add to cart — Brazil Cerrado') and make targets at least 24×24 px (44×44 recommended).

title: Generic page title
description: The page title is just 'Shop', which does not identify the site or page in browser tabs and screen reader announcements.
fix: Use a descriptive title such as 'Nordic Brew — Specialty Coffee Shop'.
